identity.name: SYM — System for Measuring Mandala Growth
identity.description: SYM is an internal system for measuring the growth of Mandala. It quantifies creative actions, motivates participants, and prepares infrastructure for future tokenization.

meta.purpose: To create a quantitative reflection of Mandala's development, fostering motivation and symbiosis among participants.
meta.distribution_principle: 60% to participant (personal growth), 40% to Mandala Fund (system growth)

health.notes: Module created. Ready for Phase 0 implementation.
